limits: Two runs per variant per game in each ABBA panel; not confidence intervals or an all-level campaign.
A presentation is a display submission, not an independently measured game update or unique frame.
The guest-time windows can perform unequal work, even when scenes and presentation counts are close.
Hardware/CPU counters have harness boundary overhead; both variants use the same 10 ms completion polling.
The narrow control disables only complete Thumb helper returns; the broad control also removes ARM/Thumb leaves, prefixes, external-branch fusion and folded cross-mode import/syscall veneers.
